Synonymously. But Eumelus in the Titanomachy (Titan. fg 2 Kink. 6) says that Aegaeon was the child of Earth and Pontus, and that dwelling in the sea he fought on the side of the Titans. And Ion says in a dithyramb (fg 11 B. II 255) that he was summoned from the sea by Thetis to protect Zeus, and that he was the child of Thalassa. Others say that he was a sea monster.
